tools.name: historian_get_recorded_values
tools.description: Retrieve raw and compressed (swinging-door) recorded values for a list of tags across a time-windowed range.

tools.name: historian_get_interpolated_values
tools.description: Retrieve interpolated values for a list of tags across a time-windowed range at a specified interval, distinctly flagged as interpolated rather than raw-recorded.

tools.name: historian_get_tag_metadata
tools.description: Retrieve tag metadata (engineering units, description, asset linkage) for a list of tags or an equipment ID's mapped tag list.

tools.name: historian_query_event_frames
tools.description: Query historian-native event frames (native start/end markers bounding an incident) overlapping a given equipment and time window, to auto-discover incident boundaries.
